title: Jira pricing - Free for 10 users, then $7.91-$14.54 per user/month cloud tiers
clean_text: Jira Cloud has four tiers: Free (up to 10 users, no time limit), Standard at $7.91/user/month (annual billing), Premium at $14.54/user/month (annual, up to 300 users), and Enterprise at custom pricing. Monthly billing raises Standard to $8.15 and Premium to $15.25 per user/month. Per-user rates drop as team size grows: roughly $8.60/user for 1-10 users versus about $7.53/user for 100+ users. Jira Data Center (self-hosted, 500+ users) started at $51,000/year, but new Data Center subscriptions stopped being sold as of March 30, 2026.
